point.title: Runtime Composition and APIs
point.rationale: The backend composition root connects application services to filesystem stores, model runtimes, browser bridges, and language services. Its Vite adapter exposes the core and mapping APIs, translates errors, controls optional capabilities, and owns shutdown. This is the strongest anchor for understanding deployment and dependency wiring.
